title: cachrys denticulata
intro: Cachrys denticulata, commonly known as Chervil or Shepherd's Needle, is a perennial plant in the carrot family (Apiaceae). It has been traditionally used for its health benefits, including its ability to aid digestion and relieve symptoms of indigestion and bloating. The therapeutic actions of Cachrys denticulata are attributed to its anti-inflammatory and carminative properties, which help to soothe the stomach and reduce discomfort. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
